last_episode_to_air.name: The Pre-Production Of Gyeongseong Love Song
last_episode_to_air.overview: Su-bin tries to help Yi-jae in every way after learning about her accident. Therefore, when pre-production for Gyeongseong Love Song begins, Su-bin goes on location scouting and Yi-jae stays indoors for the script meeting. However, it makes Yi-jae feel like she is not approved by the crew because of Su-bin’s overprotection. She even overhears colleagues’ insults about her lack of experience. Hence, he decides to show Su-bin her willpower. Meanwhile, Yu-geon gets an unexpected opportunity after arguing with his father about his dream.

name: Dream to You
overview: Dreaming of filmmaking, a passionate high schooler pushes aside all obligations to create short films, inspiring a studious but passionless classmate. Their deep bond eventually turns romantic, but they are abruptly separated when he is forced to move overseas. Years later in their thirties, their lives have completely swapped: she is a disillusioned, struggling TV reporter, while he has become an award-winning director. When a sudden reunion brings them face-to-face, he resolves to help her rediscover her lost spark, but she still harbors deep resentment over his past disappearance.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: High school exes reunite in their 30s with their life outlooks swapped – can they reconcile and heal from their pasts through the art of film?

tagline: Our greatest story has yet to be filmed.
